questions.question: Recall the challenges faced by citizen journalists while reporting.
questions.solution_html:
• o Lack of Legal & Physical Protection: Susceptibility to harassment, arrest, violence
  • and legal threats without institutional backing.
  • o Ethical & Credibility Deficits: Risk of spreading unverified information, lacking formal
  • training in verification, defamation laws, or journalistic standards.
  • o Resource Constraints: Limited funding, professional camera/audio equipment, and
  • editing infrastructure.
  • o Algorithmic Shadowbanning & Censorship: Account suspensions, platform policy
  • changes, internet blackouts, and government censorship.

questions.question: Trace the history and growth of citizen journalism.
questions.solution_html:
• o Early Roots: Pamphleteering, public forums, and early open-publishing networks
  • (e.g., Indymedia late 1990s).
  • o Milestone Events: Coverage of the 2004 Asian Tsunami, 2005 London Bombings, and
  • 2009 Iranian Protests using early camera phones and blogs.
  • o Social Media Boom: Arab Spring (2011) and widespread adoption of platforms like
  • Twitter/X, Facebook, YouTube, and WhatsApp.
  • o Modern Era: Integration of MoJo (Mobile Journalism) tools, livestreaming, hyper
  • local blogging, and citizen-led watchdog networks.
